name: checks
title: Checks
description: The six answers a criterion can have, drawn as a disc: yes `[x]`, partly `[-]`, no `[!]`, unknown `[?]`, open `[ ]` and does not apply `[/]`. The brackets are the shortcuts; `@check{pass}` is the full form, and `@check{yes, label=Residency}` puts the check and its label in a pill. The answer is one of the six ids (`pass warn fail unknown todo skip`) or its spoken word (`yes partly no open na`). Checks are part of how Lattice draws a slide, so this plugin is embedded: it loads on every render and has no off switch. Components that score a list (verdict-grid, pricing, obligation-matrix, checklist) read the same six and place a check in a pill, a row or a cell; none draws its own.
